title: Reflect button
description: A compact 36px link button with 8px corners at weight 500: a deep violet fill with a lilac rim and an inner glow rising from its bottom edge, or a near-black panel with a faint hairline. On hover the top sheen fades out and a violet glow fades up from below in 450ms on a soft ease-out.
notes: the glow is mixed from --highlight, so it follows the theme
block: stretches to the full width with the label on the left (the original's phone pricing buttons)
name: reflect-button

props.name: children
props.description: the label (an icon may sit before or after it)

props.name: variant
props.description: primary: deep violet with a lilac rim and inner glow · secondary: near-black panel with a hairline

props.name: block
props.description: stretch to the container width with the label at the left
